description:
Fan-made NieR:Automata style desktop terminal. Not affiliated with Square Enix.

LANGUAGES
English, 简体中文, 日本語, 한국어, Русский, Deutsch, Français, Español, Português (Brasil). 'Language' starts on Auto, which follows the language Wallpaper Engine reports and falls back to English. Pick one in the properties or in SYSTEM > QUICK SETTINGS.

HUB AND PLACES
The desktop is the hub. Hover a menu entry to preview it, click to go there; HUB brings you back, or the terminal returns on its own when idle.
- MAP: drag the globe, click locations to survey them
- QUESTS: time progress, your own daily orders checklist, focus timer
- INTEL: now playing, audio log, Pod archive
- ARCHIVE: character grid; click a record to deploy it to the desktop
- HACKING: BREACH, a 3D intrusion drill (fly the probe with the cursor, break the shield nodes, destroy every core), and your records
- GARDEN: plant Lunar Tears, stir the wind with the cursor
- SYSTEM: diagnostics and quick settings you can change from the desktop

FEATURES
- Live clock and date in the YoRHa menu style
- Audio visualizer, Pod log with time-aware messages, floating particles, scanlines and glitches
- Daylight, night or automatic theme (switches by the clock; set the hours in the properties)
- Menu on the left or right, works on ultrawide and portrait monitors
- Your own image or .webm video as a duotone background

CHARACTERS
A character set is included and appears right away. To use your own, set 'Character folder' to a folder of PNG renders. The file name is the name on screen: '01 - 2B - YoRHa No.2 Type B.png' shows 2B with the subtitle; the leading number only sets the order. Tall transparent PNGs (600 px high or more) stand beside the panel, breathe, emote, say your custom lines and react to clicks; other images stay in ARCHIVE. Click a record in ARCHIVE > CHARACTERS to keep it on the desktop.

PRIVACY
INTEL > AUDIO LOG lists what Media Integration picks up, browser videos included. Clear it with INTEL > CLEAR AUDIO LOG, and choose Keep, Music only, This session only or Off under 'Audio log' (also in SYSTEM > QUICK SETTINGS).

TIPS
- Turn on Media Integration in Wallpaper Engine's settings for the INTEL panel
- Allow mouse input for menu hover and character reactions

Update: 18/11/2026

- New 3D drill in HACKING: BREACH, replacing INTERCEPT and LOGIC LOCK. Fly the probe with the cursor (it fires on its own, click for a pulse), shoot down the coloured shots, dodge the ringed ones, break the shield nodes and destroy every core. Sweep, fortress and corridor stages, an upgrade after each one, records in HACKING > RECORDS. Built to stay light: it only loads when opened, lowers its resolution on slower PCs and frees its memory 30 seconds after you leave.

- 9 languages: English, 简体中文, 日本語, 한국어, Русский, Deutsch, Français, Español, Português (Brasil). Set 'Language' in the properties (Auto follows the language Wallpaper Engine reports) or switch it in SYSTEM > QUICK SETTINGS.

- Audio log privacy: INTEL > CLEAR AUDIO LOG wipes the list (click twice). New 'Audio log' setting: Keep, Music only (skips browser videos when the player reports them), This session only, Off.

- Theme: new Auto option switches between daylight and night by the clock; set the hours in the properties.

- Characters: the included set now appears without choosing a folder. Your own 'Character folder' still replaces it. ARCHIVE marks images that can't stand on the desktop (they need a transparent PNG at least 600 px tall).

- Fixed a rare error in the MAP globe.

options.label: Keep music only (skip videos the player reports, e.g. YouTube)

autocycle.text: Auto-switch panel every N seconds (0 = off)

charfolder.text: Character folder (empty = included set; PNG renders, file name = character name)

dailyorders.value: Drink some water|Stretch for five minutes|Back up your save data|Finish one task you have been avoiding

emotefreq.text: Emote frequency (0 = only react to clicks)

emotelines.value: Glory to Mankind.|...|Hm.|Systems nominal.|Is something wrong?|Proceeding with the mission.

hubreturn.text: Return to the hub after N seconds idle (0 = never)

options.label: Menu on the right (keeps desktop icons clear)
Auto (day and night by the clock)

title: YoRHa Terminal - NieR:Automata UI
